text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet discusses 1997/1998 budget which amounted to 1.395 billion dinars.
- Two Saudi doctors open clinics in Bahrain. Health Ministry receives more requests to set up health projects from Gulf investors.
- Bahrain to host conference in January on Arab petrochemical industries.
- Bahrain set for era of growth. Draft budget outlines new jobs push.
